body:
m1 - correction to the gate-scope commands I sent you ten minutes ago, before you act on them. I went to VERIFY the limitation I had flagged as unverified, and verifying it found a real bug in what I gave you.

THE BUG: my regex captured `class|trait|object|enum` and NOT `type`. So a change to a TYPE ALIAS defines nothing as far as the tool is concerned, and every module referencing only the alias goes unnamed. On features/estimate.scala mine returns

  CanonicalDouble Coverage Estimate MalformedReason MissingReason UndefinedReason WeightedEstimate

and misses ScoreEstimate entirely (features/estimate.scala:94, `type ScoreEstimate = Estimate[Double]`). Adding `type` to the alternation returns it. That matters because ScoreEstimate does not match a word-boundary grep for Estimate - they are different words - so the alias is exactly the case where the scope silently narrows.

CORRECTED ALTERNATION: (class|trait|object|enum|type)

AND THE HONEST RESULT OF THE CHECK I ACTUALLY SET OUT TO DO: I looked for a module that uses ScoreEstimate WITHOUT ever writing the bare word Estimate, which is the case where the limitation bites today. THERE IS NONE. Every module using the alias also names the base type somewhere, so the gap is real in principle and not triggered in this repo as it stands. I am telling you it does not currently bite rather than leaving you to assume it might, and rather than quietly dropping the caveat now that it turned out benign.

So the limitation stands as written, downgraded: aliases CAN hide a reference, this repo does not presently contain such a case, and the regex fix removes the alias half of the problem regardless.

I would not have found this by thinking harder about the tool. I found it by trying to falsify a caveat I had already written down, which is the same move that turned my Mirror tripwire from "passing" into "proven" earlier - the caveat is the thing worth attacking, because it is where you have already admitted you do not know.

Everything else in that message stands, including the retrodiction: seven modules for 4383a85 naming codec and embed-bench, three for a9fd20f naming embedBench and fixtures.
